To represent the history, structure, and legacy of the Roman Empire, here is a collection of (subject, predicate, object) triples categorized by topic:

### Origins and Foundation
* (Romulus, founded, Rome)
* (Rome, transitioned from, Roman Republic)
* (Augustus, became, first Emperor)
* (Julius Caesar, ended, Roman Republic)

### Governance and Structure
* (Roman Empire, occupied, Mediterranean Basin)
* (Emperor, held, absolute power)
* (Senate, provided, administrative counsel)
* (Roman Law, influenced, modern legal systems)
* (Roman Legions, maintained, imperial stability)

### Culture and Society
* (Romans, spoke, Latin)
* (Roman religion, incorporated, Greek pantheon)
* (Roman citizens, enjoyed, public baths)
* (Colosseum, hosted, gladiatorial games)
* (Christianity, became, official state religion)

### Achievements and Infrastructure
* (Roman engineers, built, extensive road networks)
* (Roman aqueducts, transported, fresh water)
* (Roman architects, perfected, the arch)
* (Concrete, revolutionized, Roman construction)
* (Roman Empire, facilitated, Mediterranean trade)

### Expansion and Decline
* (Roman Empire, reached, maximum extent under Trajan)
* (Pax Romana, provided, period of relative peace)
* (Diocletian, partitioned, Rome into East and West)
* (Constantine the Great, established, Constantinople)
* (Barbarian invasions, destabilized, Western Roman Empire)
* (Western Roman Empire, fell, in 476 AD)
* (Byzantine Empire, continued, Roman traditions in the East)

### Lasting Legacy
* (Roman Empire, shaped, Western civilization)
* (Latin, evolved, into Romance languages)
* (Roman government, influenced, modern republicanism)
* (Roman culture, preserved, Hellenistic knowledge)
